functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::add
functions.description: Adds an item to the SmallSet. Returns true if the item was not already present; returns false if an equal item already exists. Optimized to avoid heap allocations for up to two items; may transition to vector-backed storage for 3+ items.
requirements: Template parameter T should be a pointer type or trivially copyable type (as documented).
T must be equality-comparable with operator==, as membership checks rely on it.
Caller must pass a valid T value; duplicates (by equality) are ignored and return false.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::remove
functions.description: Removes an item from the SmallSet if present. Returns true if the item was found and removed; false if not found. May transition storage between None/Single/Double/Vector as size decreases.
requirements: Template parameter T should be a pointer type or trivially copyable type (as documented).
T must be equality-comparable with operator==, as removal uses equality checks.
Iterators into this set are invalidated by removal and by storage state transitions; do not use existing iterators after calling remove.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::contains
functions.signature: template <typename T> bool workerd::SmallSet<T>::contains(T item) const
functions.description: Checks whether the SmallSet contains an item equal to the given value. Performs constant-time checks for up to two items and linear search when vector-backed.
requirements: Template parameter T should be a pointer type or trivially copyable type (as documented).
T must be equality-comparable with operator==.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::size
functions.description: Returns the number of items currently stored in the SmallSet. O(1) in all storage modes.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::empty
functions.description: Returns true if the SmallSet contains no items; otherwise false.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::clear
functions.description: Removes all items from the SmallSet and resets storage to the empty state.
requirements: All existing iterators are invalidated by clear; do not use prior iterators after calling this function.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::snapshot
functions.description: Creates and returns a kj::Vector containing a copy of all current items. Intended for safe iteration when items may remove themselves or when mutations could invalidate iterators.
requirements: Template parameter T should be a pointer type or trivially copyable type (as documented).
T must be copyable/movable into kj::Vector<T>.
The snapshot is a copy; subsequent mutations to the set do not affect the returned vector.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::Iterator::operator*
functions.description: Dereferences the iterator to obtain the current item value. Performs internal bounds checks and fails a precondition if dereferencing an end or invalid iterator.
requirements: The iterator must not be at end; dereferencing end triggers a KJ precondition failure.
The iterator must be valid for the current container state; iterators are invalidated by removals or storage state changes.
Template parameter T should be a pointer type or trivially copyable type (as documented).

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::Iterator::operator++
functions.description: Pre-increment: advances the iterator to the next position and returns a reference to the iterator.
requirements: The iterator must be valid for the current container state; iterators are invalidated by removals or storage state changes.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::Iterator::operator++
functions.description: Post-increment: advances the iterator to the next position and returns the previous iterator value by copy.
requirements: The iterator must be valid for the current container state; iterators are invalidated by removals or storage state changes.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::Iterator::operator==
functions.signature: template <typename T> bool workerd::SmallSet<T>::Iterator::operator==(const workerd::SmallSet<T>::Iterator& other) const
functions.description: Compares two iterators for equality. Iterators are equal if they refer to the same SmallSet storage and the same index.
requirements: Only compare iterators originating from the same SmallSet instance; behavior relies on comparing the same storage pointer.
Iterators may become invalid after mutations; comparing invalidated iterators may trigger precondition failures elsewhere.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::Iterator::operator!=
functions.signature: template <typename T> bool workerd::SmallSet<T>::Iterator::operator!=(const workerd::SmallSet<T>::Iterator& other) const
functions.description: Inequality comparison for iterators; logical negation of operator==.
requirements: Only compare iterators originating from the same SmallSet instance.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::begin
functions.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the SmallSet (index 0).
requirements: Iterators are invalidated by removals or storage state changes; avoid using an iterator after mutating the set.

functions.name: workerd::SmallSet::end
functions.description: Returns a sentinel iterator representing one past the last element of the SmallSet.
requirements: Iterators are invalidated by removals or storage state changes; avoid using an iterator after mutating the set.
